title: Selling an item back to a shop never pays more than the shop charges
summary: Good faction standing made some shops pay more for an item than they charged for it, so buying and selling back made money. A shop now pays at most what it would charge that character for the same item.
items: Sell to shop, Sell & split and player links all follow the cap; the price you'd pay includes market events, faction standing and your Charisma.
Why this payout? shows the cap as its own line when it lowers the payout. Nothing changes where a shop already paid less than its price.
